items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: And I'll never forget, Fats was playing pool

ctx.x: Strange cats around there in those days. Very funny.

When Art first came here... I think I was working at Small's, yeah... Me and Joe carried him down to the Rhythm Club, and we played... We played about two tunes before we cut him loose. And I'll never forget, Fats was playing pool, and Fletcher and all the cats were playing cards and shit. And we was playing something, and all of a sudden, boom, we all dropped out. Boy, you could hear a rat piss on cotton, because that (?) tore that Rhythm Club up, you know.

He used to pick me up every night, you know, and we'd go to these different jobs. We used to go to one joint... He's supposed to be blind, right? Shit. It was called... The Devil's Kitchen, I think it was, or something like that. It was across Fifth Avenue... Across Lenox, between Lenox
